title: Cable tray, basket and ladder systems
summary: Introduces the types of cable tray, prefabricated tray accessories, the tray bending machine, and cable ladder and basket systems.

sections.heading: Types of cable tray
paragraphs: There are three main types of cable tray.

sections.heading: Tray accessories and tools
paragraphs: Cable tray can come prefabricated. Prefabricated fittings include a reducer, a T junction, a bend and a cross junction. A tray bending machine is a specialist tool.

sections.heading: Cable ladder and cable basket
paragraphs: Cable ladder systems are designed for heavy cable. Cable basket is similar to ladder but smaller, and is designed for smaller cable.
bullets: Cable ladder: designed for heavy cable
Cable basket: similar to ladder but smaller
Cable basket: designed for smaller cable
